def intersect_intervals(list1, list2):
    i = 0
    j = 0
    result = []
    while i < len(list1) and j < len(list2):
        start1, end1 = list1[i]
        start2, end2 = list2[j]
        # Find overlap
        overlap_start = max(start1, start2)
        overlap_end = min(end1, end2)
        if overlap_start < overlap_end:
            result.append( (overlap_start, overlap_end) )
        # Move the pointer which has the earlier end
        if end1 < end2:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return result

    # Sort and merge busy intervals (though assuming they are already sorted and non-overlapping)
    sorted_busy = sorted(busy_intervals, key=lambda x: x[0])
    free = []
    prev_end = work_start
    for start, end in sorted_busy:
        # Adjust end to be within work hours
        adjusted_start = max(start, work_start)
        adjusted_end = min(end, work_end)
        if adjusted_start >= adjusted_end:
            continue  # No overlap with work hours
        if adjusted_start > prev_end:
            free.append( (prev_end, adjusted_start) )
        prev_end = max(prev_end, adjusted_end)
    # Add the remaining after last busy
    if prev_end < work_end:
        free.append( (prev_end, work_end) )
    return free

def intersect_intervals(list1, list2):

    j = 0
